text:
You need a designer who can turn your hospitality reservation idea into a clear app experience that makes instant table booking feel simple, fast, and connected across many restaurants.

Hi David,

I’d be glad to help you shape this idea into a clean, practical product design. From what you described, the main challenge is not just making a reservation app, but designing a system that feels effortless for diners while also working smoothly for multiple restaurants on the backend. That kind of flow needs careful thinking around search, availability, booking confirmation, and live updates.

I’m Tobias Reyne, with 7 years of experience working on full stack products using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While your programming team will handle the build, I can help you define the structure and user experience so the idea is easy to understand and ready for development.

A project I’ve worked on that involved live, real-time coordination was Live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight. I built a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA, pushed to the browser as GPS pings arrive. The result was 1,800 trucks tracked live, with updates reaching the screen in under 2 seconds from ping to screen. That experience is relevant here because your app will also need to communicate live status clearly and reliably, whether that means table availability, reservation confirmation, or restaurant response timing.

For your hospitality app, I can help you think through the full user journey: how customers discover restaurants, how they check live availability, how they book a table in just a few steps, and how the restaurant side stays organized across many locations. I can also help translate your idea into wireframes or a structured product flow that your programming team can work from.

If you already have the core concept in mind, I’d be happy to help you draw it out and make it feel real.
